Extraction._comment: UsePythonChunks=true indexes extract_universal.py chunks (heading paths, real page numbers, one chunk per table row) instead of re-chunking _clean.txt with SemanticChunkAsync. Change UNIFIED_COLLECTION in EmbeddingService.cs at the same time so the two chunkings land in different collections.

Admin._comment: ApiKey is checked by AdminApiKeyFilter against the X-Admin-Key header on every /api/admin/* call. CHANGE_ME before this leaves dev; the WebForms proxy needs the same value.

Pricing._comment: Prefix-matched against OpenAI:Model / the deployment name returned by the API. Check current prices on the pricing page before trusting these.
